# omni_color_palette (Resource)

Creates a colour palette that visualisations can reference.

For embedding, a palette per tenant is how an embedded experience picks up the host application's branding. Defining them in configuration keeps branding consistent across instances rather than recreated by hand.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `colors` (List of String) Ordered hex colours, for example `["#1f77b4", "#ff7f0e"]`. Order matters: discrete palettes assign them in sequence, continuous palettes interpolate between adjacent values.
- `name` (String) Palette name. Must be unique per type within the organization.
- `type` (String) `discrete` palettes colour categories and are used in the order given. `continuous` palettes define a gradient for numeric scales and interpolate between the colours.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the palette was created.
- `id` (String) The palette's unique ID. Visualisations reference the palette by this value.
